# Experimental Plugin Record Catalog

English | [中文](experimental-persistence-catalog.zh.md)

These current-source PluginRecordMap declarations describe ignorable, log-only records owned by experimental packages. Payload annotations link to their owning source without expanding referenced types. Records stay outside the known-event set, persistence schema fingerprints, and compatibility history; format migrations retain them on a best-effort basis.

Run `pnpm run gen-persistence-catalog` to regenerate both persistence catalogs, their language pairs, and associated artifacts. `pnpm run verify-persistence-catalog` checks all generated files.

Shared Session event declarations and resolved schemas appear in the [Session persistence event catalog](persistence-catalog.md).

| Record | Owner | Purpose | Payload and source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugin:loom/adopt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-loom` | Adoption of the Session that holds it; never model-visible. | <code>LoomAdoptRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/loom/src/types.ts`](../packages/experimental/loom/src/types.ts) |
| `plugin:loom/branch` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-loom` | Branch-set membership of the Session that holds it, written before its first prompt and never model-visible. | <code>LoomBranchRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/loom/src/types.ts`](../packages/experimental/loom/src/types.ts) |
| `plugin:loom/choice` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-loom` | Selection within one prose sibling set; does not change Chat history. | <code>LoomChoiceRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/loom/src/s6-types.ts`](../packages/experimental/loom/src/s6-types.ts) |

| `plugin:loom/mark` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-loom` | Private keep or set-aside mark of the Session that holds it; never model-visible and never a feedback event. | <code>LoomMarkRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/loom/src/types.ts`](../packages/experimental/loom/src/types.ts) |
| `plugin:loom/tool-result-override` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-loom` | Source attribution of a content-only tool-result replacement in a fork. | <code>LoomToolResultOverrideRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/loom/src/s6-types.ts`](../packages/experimental/loom/src/s6-types.ts) |
